name: Prejudice And Discrimination
overview: Scripture reveals that all humanity is created in God's image and of one blood, emphasizing the inherent dignity and unity among all people regardless of background (Genesis 1:26; Acts 17:26). God's impartiality is clear, as He shows no favoritism, calling believers to adopt the same attitude and avoid judgment or condemnation of others (Acts 10:34; Matthew 7:1; Luke 6:37). Christians are exhorted to live peaceably with everyone, reflecting God's love and justice in overcoming prejudice and discrimination (Romans 12:18).
